choice: Both: each vertex must be between 0.99 x radiusM and 1.01 x radiusM / cos(pi / sides) from the center
options: Require vertices exactly at radiusM (inscribed only)
Require the polygon to fully cover the circle (circumscribed only)
text: circleRing JSDoc does not say whether the polygon sits inside the circle or around it. What do the tests accept?
why: Vertices on the circle (inscribed) and a polygon drawn around the circle so it fully covers the avoid area (circumscribed) are both fair readings of 'approximating a circle'
